data.name: Zebediah
data.long_meaning: The name Zebediah is derived from the Hebrew words ‘zeb’ meaning ‘to divide’ and ‘deh’ meaning ‘multitude’. This name signifies ‘God is my multitude’ or ‘God is my abundance’. In the Bible, Zebediah is the name of several prophets and priests, emphasizing the connection between divine guidance and abundance.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes God's abundance and divine guidance in our lives.
data.numerology_meaning: The Number Three represents creativity, self-expression, and communication. Individuals with a life path number three are often natural communicators, artists, and promoters.

in_hebrew.name: זבדייה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: זבדייה הוא שם פרטי עברי שמשמעותו 'מתנה אלוהים' או 'יבוא אלוהים'. השם מורכב משתי מילים: 'זבד' שפירושו מתנה ו'אל' שפירושו אלוהים. השם נמצא בתנ"ך מספר פעמים, ביניהן בספר עזרא ונחמיה, וגם היה שם של כהן שפעל בימי המלך יויקים.

in_greek.name: Ζεβεδιας
in_greek.long_meaning: Ζεβεδιας είναι η ελληνική μορφή του εβραϊκού ονόματος זבדייה, που σημαίνει 'Θεοδωτος' ή 'Θεοπροϊσταμενος'. Το όνομα αυτό απαντάται και στη Καινή Διαθήκη, συγκεκριμένα στα Ευαγγέλια, ως το όνομα του πατέρα των αποστόλων Ιακώβου και Ιωάννη.

in_latin.name: Zebediah
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Zebediah origine hebraicum est, quod interpretatur 'Donum Dei' vel 'Deus advenit'. Nomen in Scripturis Sacris invenitur, praesertim in libris Ezrae et Nehemiae, etiam fuit nomen sacerdotis qui floruit temporibus regis Ioakim.

in_english.name: Zebediah
in_english.meaning: Gift of God, God has given
in_english.long_meaning: The name Zebediah originates from the Hebrew name זבדייה (Zebadiah), meaning 'gift of God' or 'God has given'. It is derived from the Hebrew words 'zabad,' meaning gift, and 'El,' referring to God. The name appears in the Bible, particularly in the books of Ezra and Nehemiah, and also refers to the father of the apostles James and John in the New Testament. Zebediah symbolizes divine providence and the preciousness of spiritual gifts.

biblical_reference.note: Referenced as Zebedee, father of James and John
